So this run is the official recipe except for the language string, and whether the model reads "Persian" as its Persian tag is unknown.

Transcripts are in eval/results/moss15.json.
reading: At this recipe, on this development set, MOSS v1.5 does not beat the F5 baseline on speaker similarity, is below both OmniVoice and MOSS v1.0, and mispronounces clearly more than the baseline. The card claims v1.5 with a language tag beats v1.0 on almost all supported languages; this run's tag string was not the official one, so it cannot test that claim. Nothing here is a SOTA result.
